title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last winter, Carlos took a trip to the mountains with his brother. They traveled by bus for five hours on a long road. The hotel was warm and quiet, and the snow outside was very beautiful. Every morning, they walked in the forest and took many photos.

On the last day, they went skiing for the first time. Carlos fell many times, but he laughed and got up again. He said it was the best vacation he had ever had, and he wants to go back next year.

questions.text: How did Carlos and his brother travel to the mountains?
What did Carlos do on the last day of the trip?
options: He went skiing for the first time
He slept all day in the hotel

questions.text: How did Carlos probably feel about his trip?
Why did Carlos laugh when he fell while skiing?
options: He was not hurt and he enjoyed the experience
He wanted to make his brother angry
He was trying to win a prize
The snow was too cold to feel

vocabulary.definition: a period of time away from work or school for rest and fun

paragraph_translations: El invierno pasado, Carlos hizo un viaje a las montañas con su hermano. Viajaron en autobús durante cinco horas por un camino largo. El hotel era cálido y tranquilo, y la nieve de afuera era muy hermosa. Todas las mañanas caminaban por el bosque y tomaban muchas fotos.

El último día, fueron a esquiar por primera vez. Carlos se cayó muchas veces, pero se rio y se levantó otra vez. Dijo que fueron las mejores vacaciones que había tenido, y quiere volver el próximo año.
